title: Hearing on the Maimonides–NYC Health + Hospitals merger
summary: The Council's Committee on Hospitals will examine the planned merger of Maimonides Health System into NYC Health + Hospitals, expected to close around April 2026 and backed by a $2.2 billion state grant. The hearing will explore effects on patient care, staffing, cultural sensitivity in services, and Maimonides' finances, including an estimated $15 million operating loss in early 2025. It will also address a lawsuit from Maimonides board members seeking to block the merger and broader federal Medicaid funding cuts affecting NYCH+H.
